root_idea.summary: The root centers on holding, restraining, preventing, and remaining attached to something.
root_idea.development: From the basic idea of holding or preventing, the usage develops into protection and preservation, clinging to a protective support, fastening or binding, and marks or features that remain attached.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Quran-attested plural nominal group presented under its singular citation form.

senses.definition: To protect, defend, or preserve from harm.
senses.usage_conditions: A transitive verb of protection or preservation; in the Quran it is used of protection from people, danger, or divine decree.

senses.definition: To hold fast to, cling to, or take refuge in a protecting support.
senses.usage_conditions: Commonly constructed with بِـ or إِلَى. Quranic uses describe holding fast to God, His bond, or His guidance; the construction can also express seeking protection through that attachment.

senses.definition: To seek protection for oneself and hold oneself back from wrongdoing.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic use describes deliberately seeking what will preserve one from an immoral act; the reflexive construction focuses on self-restraint and self-preservation.

senses.definition: A protector, defender, or possessor of protective power.
senses.usage_conditions: In negated constructions, especially concerning God's decree, it means that there is no defender or source of protection; the active-participle form may also be interpreted in a possessive or quasi-passive relation to protection.

senses.definition: A marital tie or marriage bond.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic form is the plural عِصَم, used of matrimonial bonds that are no longer to be maintained.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To fit a water-skin with its tie, or to bind it with that tie.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical construction concerning the fastening of water-skins and similar leather vessels.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To gain, earn, or seek the means of subsistence.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A distinct Form I usage reported in Classical Arabic.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To adhere or stick, as dust adhering to a tooth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of dust or a similar substance becoming attached to a surface.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be marked with the characteristic feature called أَعْصَم.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reported especially of gazelles and mountain-goats, and apparently also of horses; the feature is the whiteness described under أَعْصَم.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be unsteady in one’s seat on a horse.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form IV usage associated with riding and lack of firmness in the saddle.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To prepare a handhold in a camel’s or horse’s saddle for someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The prepared object is something by which the rider can hold on to avoid falling.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become protected, defended, or preserved.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A quasi-passive Form VII usage describing the subject as receiving protection.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For a girl or young woman to apply collyrium to her eyes.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic usage unrelated to the Quranic holding-fast construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A remnant, trace, or residue of something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes a remaining trace of coloring, tar, saffron, henna, or a similar substance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A collar or bracelet-like band; by extension, something possessed or given in its entirety.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The idiom دَفَعْتُهُ إِلَيْهِ بِعُصْمَتِهِ means that it was handed over altogether, with all that belongs to it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The characteristic contrasting whiteness denoted by أَعْصَم.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a whitened extremity, especially the wrist or foreleg of an animal.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Protection, preservation, or defence from destruction, want, or harm.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun can denote ordinary protection, a defender’s support, or divine preservation; it is also used for the preservation attributed to God.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A faculty or disposition that preserves someone from disobedience while leaving the power to commit it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical theological usage, also described as an inability to disobey or a disposition preventing disobedience without coercion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A cord, strap, tie, or loop used to fasten or carry a water-skin, leather vessel, or similar receptacle.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term also extends to anything serving to secure or preserve an object, including the cords of a travelling litter.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The slender terminal part of an animal’s tail, or the tail with its hair and central strip.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A zoological usage with the plural أَعْصِمَةٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Collyrium.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Named in connection with the eye-protecting or strengthening function attributed to it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Edacious or voracious.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a she-camel or to a human being, male or female.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A woman whose family or household has become numerous.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized nominal use referring to the growth of a woman’s household or family.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A dried or adhering residue, such as sweat-rust or dirt and dried urine on a camel’s thighs.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used especially of deposits that dry onto an animal’s body.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Black hair growing beneath a camel’s fur after the outer fur has shed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized camel-related usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The leaves of trees.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A separate nominal usage reported in Classical Arabic.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Self-ennobled; noble through personal character or achievement rather than ancestry.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Contrasted with عِظَامِيٌّ, one who takes pride in inherited lineage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A name for Medina.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A proper-name usage derived from the protective sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An appellation for certain foods, especially parched barley meal and sikbāj.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A fixed food-name expression rather than a productive personal name.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A woman who sleeps for a long time and speaks angrily when roused.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized descriptive noun; the related form عَيْصَامٌ is cross-referred to this usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Having a contrasting whiteness on a forelimb, wing, leg, or analogous extremity.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to gazelles, mountain-goats, and horses for whiteness in the forelegs; applied to a crow for a rare white feature in a wing or leg. The exact body part varies by animal and lexical authority.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The wrist or the part of the forearm where a bracelet is worn; by extension, the arm.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The primary anatomical sense concerns the bracelet-bearing part of the forearm, with poetic or extended use for the arm.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A name used to call a she-goat for milking.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used without the definite article as a repeated vocative call.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place of defence, protection, or preservation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal place-of-protection usage.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Verb describing the state called أَعْصَم.
Holding fast or clinging to a support, including the reported Quranic expression.
Taking refuge and protecting oneself are covered by the holding-fast and refuge construction.
Holding fast, clinging, and taking refuge.
Collar, bracelet-like band, and related idiom.
The quality associated with أَعْصَم is represented under that adjective.
Water-skin tie, strap, loop, and protective fastening.
Cords of a travelling litter are a fastening subtype.
Dried dirt or urine is the same residue branch.
Black hair beneath shed camel fur.
Protector or defender, explicitly tied to Quranic usage.
Horse usage of the same contrasting-whiteness adjective.
Crow usage of the same adjective, with animal-specific variation.

cautions: Lane’s printed historical Quran references are not converted into modern verse locations; Quran examples here use only independently supplied QAC locations.
The Quranic plural عِصَم is presented under the supported singular dictionary citation عِصْمَةٌ.
